newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek 96 EPS revised downwards 0.6pct in September.
newsitem.headline: Greek 96 EPS revised downwards 0.6pct in September.

text.p: Financial analysts revised their 1996 earnings per share (EPS) estimates of a universe of 56 Greek equities downwards by 0.6 percent, Paris-based Associes en Finance said in its September market consensus report.
"Among low revision activity, 1996 EPS estimates were downward revised 0.6 percent with a negative balance of revisions, 27 upward revisions and 36 downward ones," it said.
Upward revisions of 1996 EPS affected the telecommunications sector by 0.9 percent, banks and financial services by 0.5 percent and foods by 0.2 percent, the report said.
Downward revisions of 1996 EPS affected the textile sector by 2.6 percent, basic goods by 2.4 percent and the miscellaneous sector by 0.7 percent.
"In weighted calculations, the 1995-96 EPS growth rate stands at 16.7 percent versus 16.0 percent last month," it said.
The average price earnings (P/E) ratio of the consensus universe in weighted calculations based on 1996 EPS is 9.9 percent versus 9.3 in August, it said.

The EPS consensus was based on forecasts provided by the following 10 firms: Alpha Brokerage, Baring Securities, Carnegie International, N.D. Devletoglou Securities, Eurosec, National Securities, Olympic Securities, Schroder Securities, Sigma Securities, Telesis Securities.
